claims.statement: After the failed Rooke match, Tom Allen issued a challenge to fight any man in the country for $2,500 to $5,000 a side and the championship of the world.

claims.statement: Jem Mace, in a letter dated London, October 27, challenged Allen to fight within fifty miles of Detroit or Pittsburgh for £200 or £1,000 a side (printed as '£1,009'), and asked Allen to deposit $250 with Frank Queen.
